josh: FYI customer INC-4312 reporting a billing spike after a streaming session. Dashboard shows ~280 tokens, invoice charged ~3.2k tokens. :eyes:

amanda: yikes. do we have a sample session id / payload?

josh: session id 6f4b2e, customer attached raw SSE transcript. paste below — looks like lots of interleaved heartbeats between token frames. can repro locally.

josh: ```
SSE: id:1
data: {"type":"tokens","count":120}

SSE: id:2
data: {"type":"heartbeat","ts":1680000000}

SSE: id:3
data: {"type":"tokens","count":80, "final":false}

SSE: id:4
data: {"type":"heartbeat","ts":1680000005}

SSE: id:5
data: {"type":"tokens","count":200, "final":true}
```

josh: customer client (web) concatenates token frames but our metering appears to be counting each SSE event as its own emission in some paths — hence double/ triple counting when heartbeats are present.

tariq: @josh can you attach runtime metering logs for that timeframe? need the MeterService events (token_emit) and the SSE framing traces. also include client User-Agent.

josh: attaching excerpt: 

josh: ```
[2026-03-11T14:22:55Z] MeterService: token_emit session=6f4b2e tokens=120 chunk_id=1
[2026-03-11T14:22:55Z] SSE: out id=2 event=heartbeat
[2026-03-11T14:22:56Z] MeterService: token_emit session=6f4b2e tokens=80 chunk_id=2
[2026-03-11T14:22:56Z] SSE: out id=4 event=heartbeat
[2026-03-11T14:22:57Z] MeterService: token_emit session=6f4b2e tokens=200 chunk_id=3
```

tariq: thanks. two hypotheses: 1) heartbeats are being counted as zero‑length token frames but our aggregator later sums per‑event instead of per‑token, or 2) SDK/agent replay path resends partially acked frames and MeterService double-counts on retry.

amanda: customer said they use an older SDK (browser 0.8.1). we recently added heartbeat control events in 0.9.x — could be older client treating them as data.

elaine: quick repro I ran: using a tiny SSE generator we emit heartbeat events between chunks and then close normally. Observed meter delta: dashboard tokens=400 but ledger recorded 2.9k. Looks like finalization logic multiplies chunk counts when heartbeat markers are present.

elaine: reproduction steps:
1) run server snippet that yields three token frames with heartbeats in between (curl --no-buffer).
2) call ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer x" http://local:8080/stream | tee out.sse```
3) check /internal/meter/session/6f4b2e

elaine: sample curl to simulate: 
```bash
python - <<PY
import time,sys
print('data: {"type":"tokens","count":120}')
sys.stdout.flush(); time.sleep(0.2)
print('data: {"type":"heartbeat"}')
sys.stdout.flush(); time.sleep(0.2)
print('data: {"type":"tokens","count":80}')
sys.stdout.flush(); time.sleep(0.2)
print('data: {"type":"heartbeat"}')
sys.stdout.flush(); time.sleep(0.2)
print('data: {"type":"tokens","count":200, "final":true}')
sys.stdout.flush()
PY
```

josh: observed behavior: MeterService emits individual token_emit events for each token frame (good) but the ledger finalizer also receives an opaque "frame_count" that was incremented for heartbeats (not expected). looks like the stream framing code sets frame_count++ on any SSE event rather than only token frames.

tariq: that matches. quick fix: change framing.code to only increment frame_count when event.type=="tokens" and add a regression test emitting control frames. low-risk patch.

amanda: can we ship a server-side hotfix to stop counting heartbeats immediately? customer on enterprise plan so they need an invoice adj.

tariq: yes — I can open a patch: runtime/inbound/framer.go: check event type before counting. will push a patch and feature flag it.

support-bot: Created ticket INC-4312 and linked billing hold: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4312 :white_check_mark:

josh: thanks. for mitigation advise customer update to browser SDK 0.9.4+ which emits heartbeat as ":heartbeat" control event (SDK already sends meta: {control:true}) so older servers treat it as data.
